horoscopes.horoscope: Ganesha advises you to look before you leap. One hasty decision may undo a lot of hard work accomplished over a long period of time. After a tense morning, you may simply want an evening with kids, helping them grow the Dahlias. Things may settle down by the evening and you can expect a romantic evening with your sweetheart. You may like to get horny with your loved one. You are likely to be satisfied with your partner. All’s well that ends well. Ganesha foresees that you may be occupied at work today. Just don’t let the workload affect your health. This is the time when your work will get recognition, but it won’t be easy. Health looks good. You’ll spend more time with family. If you have invested money jointly with someone (with life partner or business partner), you will see your money growing. Alternatively, it’s ideal day to invest money jointly with someone else. The day won’t begin too well and you would struggle to stay in a positive frame of mind. You may remain dissatisfied with some professional action and will turn impatient. Arguments with your superiors are on the cards till afternoon, feels Ganesha.

Love is on the cards, says Ganesha. Your senses are likely to remain highly active today. Stay alert and avoid drifting into your own world at the cost of work. It is best for you to keep your eyes and ears open to avoid any misunderstanding with your near and dear ones, suggests Ganesha. You might expect more from your loved one, but Ganesha tells you to expect an average day on the love front. You need to remain cautious so that your words do not hurt your sweetheart. Make sure that ego does not reign your mind and affect the smooth relationship. You may be engaged at work throughout. But make sure it does not affect your health. Take some break and plan your future. You’ll feel energetic at work. Health needs a bit care. Ganesha advises, you to make a proper diet chart and follow it. This day doesn’t indicate huge expense, you are likely to remain concerned about your financial strength throughout the day. If you are in partnership business, then your finances will be good. Professional life will be very demanding today. So get prepared for some tough challenges. Try to avoid attending meetings as they will only make you more nervous. You need to remain cool under pressure in order to avoid conflicts, suggests Ganesha.

You have been aching to arrange a family reunion or get-together at your house. Well, today is the perfect day to do it. And why just family? You are also likely to invite some of your close friends and important business associates over to your place. Your spouse will enjoy the company of your loved ones. You may have to work till late and your beloved may be fast asleep by the time you reach home. You may not give adequate time to your beloved. Things will not work if you come late and force your sweetheart to stimulate romance. Your workplace will be full of activities and you will be needed to solve difficult issues. You will stay completely busy in solving them. You will be able to solve them using special skills. Your partner may not be supportive which could cause you unhappiness. Try to cut down on luxuries and control your buying impulses. Your love for electronic gadgets and communication instruments can burn a hole in your pocket, feels Ganesha. Unfortunately, you will struggle to finish work on time. When you will think that you’ve finished your day’s quota, more work will pile up. Planning and scheduling the tasks will help achieve your target or deadline. You have to use logic when things don’t happen.

Today, you will be extremely impulsive and spontaneous, feels Ganesha. You better get rid of your negative thoughts and beliefs and start taking charge of things at hand. Also, stop focussing so much on the pitfalls, and start working. Listen to music that speaks to your heart and you will be at peace with yourself. The more you respect your partner, the more affection you will get in return. Domestic activities are likely to take place. You may try to learn something new from your sweetheart. Cooking with your soulmate will pacify your’s mind, says Ganesha. You will be in a happy mood. You are very fast and efficient at work. Today, your boss is going to accept this fact. You will search the web a lot, trying to look for a crucial piece of information, says Ganesha. For buying new stocks, the day looks good. Ganesha feels that you should make the most out of this favourable day in order to increase your fiscal strength considerably. Things will be in your luck today, predicts Ganesha. Your punctuality and penchant for accuracy will be applauded in the workplace. These abilities will also help you perform tasks more efficiently. You are likely to broaden your professional horizon, says Ganesha.

The ever energetic Scorpio’s dictionary lacks the word dependence, says Ganesha. And true to this, you shall remain very active today. Your abundant energy will allow you to take work by its horns, and this will go a long way in giving you the moniker ‘workaholic’. So, wipe the slate clean by finishing all pending tasks, as today, you shall be immersed in work. The difference of opinions may block your relationship. You should be a good listener when you are with your sweetheart since this is the only way to avoid arguments. Learning from your mistakes may re-open the door of a smooth relationship, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you might not be very pleased with things happening around you. You may have second thought on your decisions now. You may get stress and it may affect your health adversely. Due to mood swings you may feel more upset. Inflow of finances is going to be rather sluggish today, predicts Ganesha. You would do well to keep your purse strings tight, and not spend on anything, or your saving reserves will get depleted. You are determined to be unshakeable today. It is essential that you use the right words to express your views in the meetings or else people will get the wrong impression and it will hamper your progress on the career front.

Leadership is your forte and you shall receive kudos for the manner in which you handle your team. Much awaited promotions will materialise and so will some extra cash in your wallet. Wisely enough, you didn’t get all this by not effectively balancing home and work, says Ganesha. Don’t slip on this tight-rope walk. Lucky Colour Light Bottle Green You may be over demanding toady. Arguments with your beloved are on the cards. So stay cautious. It’s better to try to be humble to keep your partner happy. You will manage your emotions better when your sweetheart is with you. Ganesha advises you to utilize your time and energy properly and concentrate more on the pending tasks today. There may be some urgent task to be completed now. You’ll be in good mood today. Try to be more careful for health related matters. Today Ganesha feels that you shall pay a lot of attention to financial matters as your funds’ situation is going to be tight. You have certain ideas about money and you will pave your own path. You may examine other works in order to guide them the right path. You should not criticise your colleagues or else they may think you are acting too smart. You may not be on the top of the world today.

Expect some annoyance from the ‘man in the chair’, or people in charge who may be looking towards throwing a wench in your way. But know that it is just a blip on the radar. Your fortune is too powerful for anyone to affect it negatively. Stick to your task and dig into your imagination to find a way around the blips. Your ability to think out-of-the-box will perplex your perpetrator, chuckles Ganesha. Today you will look more charming in the eyes of your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. He/she wants you to stimulate passion. Hence, you should ignore the minor faults of your beloved so as to ensure a greater harmony and peace. You will be happy because your hard work is going to bear fruits today. You will be rewarded for your work. As a development to this, you could be assigned more and bigger responsibilities. However, on personal front an odd conversation with your partner can make you feel uneasy Your hard-earned money will be coming back to you in few days when planetary transits improve. For now, you will have to deal with the difficult situations, says Ganesha. The important meetings are on the cards and your seniors are most likely to expect you to keep your voice in front of the audience. Today, the words you use can complicate conversations and rattle relationships. As a balanced Libran, you should take a finely attuned approach towards others.

Your rung in the social ladder just went higher today. But be wary of green-eyed monsters and ill words. Fight tooth and nail – if necessary – to protect our reputation, says Ganesha. But also learn to find your enemies’ Achilles’s heel and target it ferociously. Changing your approach towards life will reveal the real you. Try to solve the problems you are facing in love. You may take the help of your near and dear ones. Managing emotional complexity will be a challenge. You need to avoid criticizing your soulmate. Today is a good day on the health front. As a result, you will be able to take and successfully finish-off the difficult task. This will impress you seniors at work. Ganesha therefore advises you to keep focused and attend all tough tasks. You shall be in your original mood for money matters today, feels Ganesha. You feel it is important to build your financial profile, because it is what makes you consider yourself to be successful. You may remain serious and commanding today, says Ganesha. As a result, people will avoid coming to you with minor queries. Managing responsibilities and complex issues make you a little stubborn. You need to control your emotion, feels Ganesha.

Your business is likely to grow with leaps and bounds, foresees Ganesha. Increase in financial returns will keep you happy for the entire day. Work in progress gives out positive signals. Your expert advise will be valued at work. In short, a day full of activities. Your efforts to sort out issues on the love front will go in vain as your partner may not be in a mood to listen. You should have patience and wait for the right time to express your love, suggests Ganesha. You should try to stay objective today. This is because due to blocking of your positive thinking you could create misunderstanding between you and others. You have to avoid this situation. You need to guard yourself against negativity today, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that because the day is not looking good for your money matters, you shouldn’t try to push yourself hard to invest money in anything. It won’t work for you. Things seem to be average today. You may get a winning idea and not like to share your views with others. You are thinking of people who matters the most and may want to surprise your team. You may give written suggestions to your higher authorities to improve the workplace situation, feels Ganesha.

Your exuberance and self-confidence will become the talk of the day for those around you. But it’s not for nothing that you will attract so much attention. You will derive pleasure in accomplishing herculean tasks today, and Ganesha says you will do justice to work too. At home, everything will go smooth and you will enjoy and share the peace in your life with your wife. On the whole, you will have a cheerful day ahead. Your concern about what your beloved thinks of you will distract you today. You may be in a good mood to spend a quality time with your spouse. It’s time to express what you think about your life. You will be the best person to appreciate your partner’s feeling. Ganesha fels, that instead of wasting time and energy over futile tasks, just remain focussed on productive activities. With this you can make progress at work. Health needs care. Try to avoid over oily or junk food. You may visit some relative today. Today you are likely to have gain on the financial front. This is going to make you feel spirited to work harder to achieve your goals. If you are a professional, you might want to work more. Ganesha finds you addressing a lot of people today. If you want to sort out the problems in life try to be nice to everyone. You will succeed in finding out the problems and their solutions too. The time supports you to be bold and proactive, says Ganesha.

Team work and cooperation bring out the best in you, so you must make the most of a chance to work in a group. It could be brainstorming, or campaigning for an environmental cause or even playing beach ball! A game of cards in the evening, and consider your day well spent, says Ganesha. Your focus on work will keep you away from enjoying your love life, foresees Ganesha. Managing the time will be the key to sustaining your relationship. Hence, you are advised to sort out the important issues and maintain a harmonious relationship. Today you may face some health issues. In such situations, you need to give priority to your health now. Ganesha also suggests postponing tasks that can be done tomorrow as this is not a favorable day on the professional front. Today you are going to do very well in your field of work, foresees Ganesha, which will be directly linked to your financial progress. You shall invest more efforts in your job. You will put in a hard day at work to achieve success on the career front. You will understand that there is no substitute for hard work. You will prove yourself to those challenging your abilities. Ganesha feels that hard and smart work both will eventually give positive results.

The workaholic in your bursts to the fore with a vengeance, and today will see you tackle pending projects with the zeal of a Holy Templar crusader. Your energy levels will be unflagging, and your enthusiasm to wipe your slate clean admirable. Make the most of it, says Ganesha. Your emotional need is high today, foresees Ganesha. Your bond with your companion becomes stronger today. You love to be in the fantasy with your sweetheart and share some mindblowing stories. If you find your sweetheart unhappy, this is the time to encourage your partner, says Ganesha. You are likely to remain happy this entire day, says Ganesha. You will be in a good mood, as things will go as you have planned. Your work at the office will be praised and this will motivate others. Health needs attention. You shall enjoy the evening with your friends. With luck completely in your favour, today you are going to rock, feels Ganesha. You will be able to earn good money. If you have invested in the stock market, returns will be satisfactory. You will find the right direction and start working with full enthusiasm, leaving all the confusions behind, You will find yourself in a position to clear all doubts regarding responsibilities or projects that you have been assigned. You will feel proud to shoulder some important responsibilities for your company.
